record.content: The January 2015 brochure describes Sycamore as very shady, Cathedral as densely shaded and cool in summer, and the other five sites by their views. It gives capacities of 3 to 30 people. These are historical brochure statements; current ReserveAmerica site pages independently corroborate capacities and most shade fields. Fees, reservation procedures, closures, and other operating rules printed in this older brochure are not treated as current facts.
